scripts.dev: concurrently -n kronos,api,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run kronos:dev" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n kronos,api,web "npm run kronos:dev" "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
